title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 7-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$7$$ parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the remaining $$6$$ parts are used for training. How many times does each data point appear in the training set?

title: Exploring Hyperparameter Combinations
text: Milena is testing $$2$$ values of lambda and $$5$$ values of rho. How many different combinations of lambda and rho does she need to test?

title: Calculating Total Model Fits
text: Consider the number of hyperparameter combinations and the number of cross-validation folds. How many total model fits will Milena perform?

title: Data Point Usage in Model Fitting
text: Each data point is used in the training set for $$6$$ out of the $$7$$ folds. Given the total number of model fits, how many times is each data point used to fit a model?
